free_design.Place: A quiet wave-testing pool at a modern riverside safety museum, with small floating barrier modules and a pool ladder.
free_design.Activity: She tests how a little floating barrier keeps ripples away from a fragile paper boat, studying the result with a private smile; as she steps onto the bottom rung, the small loose swim-skirt panel bunches at her hip, exposing more of her upper thigh while the opaque swim bottom stays fully secure.
free_design.Pose: One foot on a submerged ladder rung, weight on the other leg, torso turning gently toward camera; right hand places a foam barrier on the water and left hand grips the ladder rail, both hands attached naturally and visible.
free_design.Framing: Three-quarter frontal full-body view at chest height, the pool experiment visible beside her and her face clearly readable.
free_design.Outfit: A coral-red longline balconette swim top with double broad shoulder bands and opaque lined cups, paired with matching fitted high-cut swim shorts and a tiny split-front wrap swim-skirt panel fastened at the hip; no armor or faction trim.
